dedupe_keys.name: reseau routier de l isere points de repere

description: Réseau routier de l'Isère - Points de repère is a dataset listed in Opendata Isère open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de l'Isère. Ce jeu de données représente la localisation géographique du bornage des routes départementales en Isère, plus quelques RD limitrophes, nationales, autoroutes et métropolitaines. La localisation des bornes est actualisée régulièrement en partie par des prestataires et en partie par les agents des routes positionnés en territoire. Coverage: Isère. The portal files it under Mobilités. Its keywords are Routes, Bornage, Isère. The portal shows 8,060 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-isere-fr-portal.
